verdict.rationale: Conductor explicitly supports "Bring your own subscriptions and keys" and lets users "Sign in to your Cursor subscription for cloud workspaces," showing it can leverage existing subscriptions for at least some agents. However, evidence doesn't confirm this works uniformly for all supported agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) beyond Cursor, and community threads raise concerns about GitHub permission scope rather than confirming subscription sign-in flows across the board. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode subscriptions can be signed into directly (not just Cursor), independent hands-on confirmation of the sign-in flow working smoothly.
